$comment: Which upgrades need --allow-migrations, one row per release, newest last. deployment/QUICKSTART.md section 8 shows it as a table generated by node scripts/release/upgrade-matrix.mjs --write; npm run check:release-docs fails when that table is stale or the newest release in releases/ has no row. flag: no | always | when (then 'when' completes 'Only when ...'). from: the releases the row covers. upgrading: the UPGRADING.md anchor.

rows.note: HiveMem moves to 1.8.0, ChatterMost and its migrator to 0.7.0; other pins and storage formats stay unchanged.
Only Cindertrace moves, to 0.7.2; the controller and every other pin stay those of 3.11.0.
Oathweave 2.3.1, HiveMem 1.8.1, Emberpath 2.5.2, Magnus and its host agent 3.1.2, Ardent Project Studio 0.4.3; no storage format changes. New controller: run it from its own release checkout.

rows.when: HiveMem has data owned by `hive-router` (an installation migrated from the native Hive Router), which moves to `emberpath`
rows.note: Cindertrace 0.8.0, HiveXUI 0.10.0, HiveMem 1.9.0, Emberpath 2.5.3, Magnus and its host agent 3.1.3. New controller.
Every product pin stays that of 3.12.0; new controller. From 3.11.2 straight, the flag of 3.12.0 applies.
Cindertrace 0.8.1, with no schema migration; new controller. From 3.11.2 straight, the flag of 3.12.0 applies.

HiveMem 1.9.1, HiveXUI 0.10.1, Hive Registry 1.3.2, none with a schema migration. Every container gets a bounded Docker log, so the first upgrade to 3.12.3 recreates every container, datastores included; data is kept, but `docker logs` loses the history of each replaced container. New controller. From 3.11.2 straight, the flag of 3.12.0 applies.
The controller is that of 3.12.7; the launcher still runs 3.12.9 from its own release checkout. 3.12.8 was tagged but never published.
New controller. HiveXUI's Installed software view: before the upgrade add the `hivexui-registry` browser client policy to Oathweave, and after it run `./hive.sh console-clients add`.
The same products; controller fixes for the rehearsal before an upgrade and for installations migrated from native services.
The same products; `post-upgrade` records the browser-clients checklist item when Oathweave already has every client.
Magnus 3.2.1 (server, fleet gateway and host agent); otherwise 3.13.2.
3.13.3 with the Hive Registry 1.4.2.
The products of 3.13.4; `magnus-agent install` on the Magnus host records the agent checklist item.
Emberpath 2.6.0's data format, `emberpath-managed-format-3`. Ardent Project Studio 0.5.1 also runs one-way migrations on its first start: keep the pre-change backup.
Magnus 3.3.3, HiveSkills 1.9.1, Cindertrace 0.8.2 and PostgreSQL images with Zstandard 1.6.0; new controller. Upgrade the Magnus host agent first.

rows.when: the installation has a suite-managed Magnus (the full profile): one fast, additive Magnus migration
rows.note: Magnus 3.3.5, agent definitions and Ardent 3.2.1.
Magnus 3.3.6. From 3.14.0 or 3.14.1, the flag of 3.14.2 applies.

Oathweave 2.6.0 (`oathweave-managed-format-2`, one-way) and HiveSkills 1.11.1 (`hiveskills-managed-format-5`) change their data formats; full installations also apply Cindertrace, Embermend and Magnus migrations, and Ardent Project Studio 0.7.0 runs one-way migrations on its first start. ChatterMost moves from 0.7.2 to 0.10.0 directly. The way back is the pre-upgrade backup. Upgrade the Magnus host agent first.

Oathweave 2.7.0, Emberpath 2.10.0 and HiveXUI 0.14.0 together, none with a data format change; new controller. Run `post-upgrade` afterwards: it adds the browser sign-in settings and turns the Emberpath password relay off. From 3.14.x, the flag of 3.15.0 applies.
